result.description: Attio is a customizable, AI-native CRM platform for managing pipeline, deals and accounts.
result.auth_detail: OAuth 2.0 for multi-workspace apps; API key (access token) from app developer settings for single workspace. Both sent as Bearer token. Workspace-level OAuth tokens need workspace admin.
result.access_detail: API and webhooks and MCP are listed on every plan including Free (up to 3 users). Unpublished OAuth apps can be installed in up to 25 workspaces; a published/approved release is implied for wider distribution (details unverified). Workspace admin approves user scopes on install.
result.api_notes: Public REST API, JSON over HTTPS, with guides for rate limiting, webhooks, filtering, pagination. Rate limits: Read 100 req/s, Write 25 req/s. Endpoint group list not directly verified from fetched pages; MCP tool groups cover records/objects, lists, notes, tasks etc. Breadth rated from general knowledge of the Attio API reference (objects, records, lists, entries, notes, tasks, comments, webhooks, meetings).

evidence.quote: You should prefer the OAuth 2.0 flow if building an app for multiple workspaces.
If you only need a token for a single workspace, you can generate an API key in the developer settings page of your apps.
Yes. The Free plan costs nothing for up to three users.
An unpublished app can be installed in up to 25 workspaces.
Attio provides a public REST API which exchanges JSON over HTTPS.
Attio MCP is Attio's hosted MCP server that gives AI tools secure access to your Attio workspace.
Attio MCP uses OAuth authentication, so you simply log in with your Attio account—no API keys required.
Attio is the platform that builds pipeline, advances deals, and grows accounts around the clock.
